例句：As everybody’s here, let’s begin.
大家都到齐了，我们就开始吧。
例句：In the third year students begin the study of classical Chinese.
学生在三年级开始学古代汉语。
例句：The president begins talks with the prime minister tonight.
总统将于今晚和首相展开会谈。

heavily
音标：英 /'hevɪlɪ/  美 /'hɛvɪli/
adv. 在很大程度上，大量地
短语：rain heavily — 下大雨
例句：I became heavily involved in politics.
我深陷政治之中。
例句：The report was heavily criticized in the press.
该报道遭到了新闻界的严厉批评。
例句：a heavily populated area
人口密集地区
例句：thousands of heavily armed troops
全副武装的数千人的部队
例句：His wife was heavily pregnant at the time.
那时他妻子已经待产。

suddenly
音标：英 /ˈsʌdnlɪ/  美 /'sʌdnlɪ/
adv. 突然地
例句：I suddenly realized that there was someone following me.
我突然意识到有人跟着我。
例句：George died very suddenly.
乔治死得非常突然。
例句：Suddenly, the eagle opened its wings.
突然，鹰展开翅膀。
